seo.title: Website Maintenance & Care Plans | SynergyFirst Digital
seo.metaDescription: Website maintenance and care: hosting, SSL, security, backups, monitoring and monthly content updates so your website stays fast, safe and current.
seo.ogDescription: Reliable updates, backups, security checks and technical support that keep your website healthy after launch.

sections.subheading: Reliable updates, backups, security checks and technical support that keep your website healthy after launch.

sections.heading: Launch is a milestone, not the finish line
body: A website needs ongoing attention: software to keep current, security to keep tight and content to keep accurate. Left alone, sites slow down, break or fall out of date, and customers notice.

Our care service takes that work off your plate. We host, secure and maintain your website, and we make the content updates you ask for, so you can run your business while the site stays in good shape.

sections.heading: What our website care and maintenance includes
sections.intro: Care is built into every managed website plan.

items.title: Domain, hosting, SSL and security
items.body: Included in every plan, so your site is online, encrypted and protected.

items.title: Uptime monitoring
items.body: Monthly uptime monitoring helps us spot and fix availability problems.

items.title: Monthly content updates
items.body: A defined number of updates each month covers changes such as new offers, hours, images and text. Lite includes 10, Business 20 and E-Commerce 40.

items.title: Priority support on larger plans
items.body: Business adds priority support, and E-Commerce adds same-day support and a dedicated account manager.

items.title: Analytics reporting
items.body: Basic analytics on every plan, monthly reporting on Business and an advanced dashboard on E-Commerce.

items.title: WordPress maintenance
items.body: For existing WordPress sites we can handle updates, backups and security checks. Talk to us about your setup.

sections.heading: Support that grows with you
body: Your website is kept in shape by a team that already knows your business, and you can ask for improvements as your needs change. When you need something more, such as a new page or a new feature, we scope it with you.
After three continuous months of paid subscription on any plan, the complete website can be transferred to your own hosting at no charge. See the subscription terms for details.
